notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.
